response.text: My career has been a journey from curious coder to enterprise cloud architect! I started as a freelance frontend developer in 2017, founded Iglumtech in 2019 to help startups with full-stack and DevOps solutions, and now I'm at Infometics leading cloud infrastructure for UBA Group. Each step taught me something invaluable.
